scope: Only exact shim compile then plugin link; descriptor only after actual plugin capture; original observer object reused
signal_capture_scope: Received SIGTERM/INT until handler restoration above; later signals are outside this receipt. Outer nonzero/absent/partial receipt cannot establish acceptance.
completion_scope: complete is a pre-final-write candidate, not a final acceptance result. Outer returncode0 after the end-of-closure wall check is separately required; later interpreter teardown is outside the receipt timing/signal scope.
